title: M1: Domain Owner Identity Resolution (R1)
intent: Extract domain owner name, org, and country from RDAP/WHOIS records, handle thin-to-thick registry traversal, and display owner card in UI
summary: Implemented vCard 4.0 (RFC 7095 / RFC 6350) parsing in passiveReconAgent to extract fn, org, and country. Added rel: related link traversal for thin registries (Verisign/PIR) with SSRF validation, handle fallback, and privacy redaction classification. Updated sourceEnrichmentAgent with RFC citations and ISO-3166 country normalization. Enhanced DomainIntelligenceView RDAP card.
